dedupe_keys.name: energy saving from reduced building consumption in valladolid city

description: Two companion dataset titles identify reduced building energy consumption and associated carbon savings in Valladolid. The saved descriptions attribute summer effects to shading and evapotranspiration and winter effects to the insulating effect of plants. The energy indicator was calculated for the URBAN GreenUP monitoring programme. The pair is grouped by its explicitly shared building-consumption subject; the cached metadata does not establish identical samples, a common numerical model, calculation units or observed savings. The broader green-infrastructure energy deposit is not included because its overlap with these building indicators and sewer-treatment savings remains unresolved. Coverage is limited to the named city. A separately available simulation implementation is not established, and related project indicators do not prove identical numerical inputs. Only cached descriptive metadata was used. Creator, licence, file formats and access terms were omitted from the saved inventory and remain unknown. No underlying values or files were inspected.
